blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— Former world title challenger Jayson Mama has arrived in Los Angeles with his trainer as he enters the final stretch of his preparation for a major title fight against unbeaten American prospect Dominique Crowder on October 10 in Kansas City. The Sanman Boxing Gym fighter from General Santos City will challenge Crowder for the WBA/NABA USA bantamweight title at Memorial Hall as part of the Heart of America Pro-Amateur Boxing Invitational. The bout is scheduled for October 10 in the United States, or Sunday, October 11 in the Philippines. FOR BOXING FANS: Battle at Fort San Pedro: CCSC, […]...
